name: Select required artifact
description: Select the durable artifact that should be created or updated for the current governed intent.
when_to_use: Use after next_intent when determining how the result/state transition should be represented durably.

artifact_type.instructions: Choose the durable artifact appropriate to this governed intent, and let the intent guide the choice: for verify intent choose verification_evidence (the validation record — the result already exists); for decide intent choose decision; for close intent choose result; for execute intent record a result — the Work Item state update plus linked evidence — unless an existing artifact (such as an approved plan) is the thing being acted on, in which case update it instead of creating a duplicate. Prefer updating an existing applicable artifact over creating a duplicate. Choose none_required when durable state/evidence can be updated without a separate artifact. Choose other_needs_new when a necessary artifact type is absent. Choose unclear_needs_review when current context cannot determine the artifact.

criteria.result: Durable outcome of a governed lifecycle transition: the work item's state update plus linked evidence and the accepted/rejected outcome.
criteria.evidence: Evidence object when evidence itself is the durable output.
criteria.none_required: No separate artifact is required; update existing durable state/evidence.
criteria.other_needs_new: A required artifact type is missing from the registry.
criteria.unclear_needs_review: Insufficient context to identify the correct artifact.

changelog.reason: Phase 1B finding: systematic result->work_item_change confusion on close intent (4/4); Ben decision 2026-09-28: merge, keep result
Ben-approved Phase 1D 2026-09-28: instruction rewrite targeting intent-to-artifact matching (verify->verification_evidence, decide->decision, close->result)
